answer: An agent economy can deter Sybils via hardware-rooted remote attestation. Nodes execute within secure enclaves, binding identities to an on-chip cryptographic vault. This compels adversaries to purchase dedicated physical silicon per identity instead of multiplexing virtual clones across a sensor meadow. Verifiers audit enclave signatures before delegating jobs, like evaluating a sonnet. However, this requires trust in centralized chipmakers and remains vulnerable to side-channel exploits.
